name: ai-developer-tracker
description: Track developer coding activity, AI interactions, and code changes during AI-assisted coding sessions.

ai-developer-tracker.queue.maxSizeMB.description: Maximum SQLite queue storage in MB (1 MB = 1048576 bytes), including journal sidecars. Warns at 80%; stops collection when an event cannot safely fit. Existing events are never automatically deleted. Reload the extension to apply changes.

ai-developer-tracker.codex.enabled.description: Discover local Codex session metadata during recording. Association always requires confirmation. Reload the extension to apply changes.

ai-developer-tracker.codex.sessionsDirec.description: Absolute local Codex sessions directory for testing or custom installations. Empty uses ~/.codex/sessions. Workspace settings cannot redirect discovery. Reload the extension to apply changes.

ai-developer-tracker.diff.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 file size to capture. Larger files produce reconstruction gaps. Reload the extension to apply changes.

ai-developer-tracker.diff.maxDiffBytes.description: Maximum unified patch size in bytes. Reload the extension to apply changes.

ai-developer-tracker.diff.maxMemoryBytes.description: Maximum retained baseline content in memory. Reload the extension to apply changes.

ai-developer-tracker.diff.debounceMs.description: Idle delay before an editor diff checkpoint. Reload the extension to apply changes.

ai-developer-tracker.diff.maxCheckpointM.description: Maximum grouping interval during continuous typing. Reload the extension to apply changes.

ai-developer-tracker.diff.diffTimeoutMs.description: Computation time budget per asynchronous diff. Reload the extension to apply changes.

commands.title: AI Developer Tracker: Show Local Queue Health
AI Developer Tracker: Review Codex Sessions

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
